_meta.purpose: Process-noun aliases for PSI-MOD residue terms. Papers write 'phosphorylation'; PSI-MOD names the term 'phosphorylated residue'. Each value is a PSI-MOD *name*, resolved against _psimod_index.json at load time — never a hardcoded MOD id — so a PSI-MOD release that renames or retires a term drops the alias instead of emitting a stale CURIE.
_meta.authority: HUPO-PSI PSI-MOD controlled vocabulary (https://github.com/HUPO-PSI/psi-mod-CV). Alias keys are standard biochemical process nouns; no key is a tool name, project name or corpus string.
_meta.excluded: Ubiquitination has no residue-agnostic PSI-MOD parent (only 'ubiquitinylated lysine'), so mapping the general process there would narrow the claim. Left unresolved on purpose.
